concept.title: Controls
concept.shortdesc: The control knobs on the pedal allow you to shape how your signal is compressed.

strow.stentry: The GAIN REDUCTION meter shows the level of compression applied in real time.
The RELEASE knob controls how quickly compression stops after the signal falls back down.
The ATTACK knob controls how quickly compression is applied after a note is played.

The RATIO determines how strongly the signal is compressed once it exceeds the threshold. For example, the 4:1 setting means that any signal with the input level 4 decibels above threshold will only rise by 1 decibel. This effectively reduces the input gain by 3 decibels.
